remarks: This home is the perfect blend of privacy and convenience. Located on a tree-lined, one-acre parcel, this home is a short drive from Findley Lake and I-86, putting shopping and dining within easy reach. Inside, the first floor has a spacious in-law suite, fully equipped with a modest kitchen, a bathroom, and laundry hook-ups. This space could be used as an in-law suite, a lounge, or turned into an entertaining space. Additionally,  this space could be rented out to generate some additional income. With proper permitting, this could even be a home daycare. The second floor is the main living area and offers a country kitchen with a living/dining combo. The kitchen has stainless steel appliances and an island. The second floor has two bedrooms and a full bath, laundry hook-ups, and a wood-paneled three-season room that will be your favorite place to watch the seasons change. The second floor has large decks off the front and the back of the house, perfect for entertaining. The back deck has stairs that lead to the backyard, where you will find a basketball court, room for gardening, and an oversized shed for storing lawn equipment and toys. The shed has a concrete floor and electricity, and could potentially be used for workshop space. The appliances come with the house, but no guarantees are being made. The garage is located under the house and is 27 x 17.
